description: Local scour at a vertical circular pier D = 0.2 m in a steady current (h = 0.3 m, U = 0.3 m/s, d50 = 0.97 mm), CFD with k-omega and the Exner model (tutorial 11_18). Release: 21 h of sediment time (S 19 75600); the equilibrium scour depth S/D must lie in the range of established estimates: HEC-18/CSU 1.20 (K1 = 1, K2 = 1, K3 = 1.1), Sumer et al. 1.3 (sigma 0.7). Nightly: 1 h of sediment time on a coarse grid as a smoke test (scour must start, S/D between 0.05 and 2).

reference.citation: Arneson et al. (2012) FHWA HEC-18 (CSU pier scour equation); Sumer, Fredsoe & Christiansen (1992) J. Waterway, Port, Coastal, Ocean Eng. 118, S/D = 1.3 (sigma 0.7) for live-bed current scour; see refdata/misc/pier_scour.txt
